```diff
+ /// Apply vibrancy to the floating bar window
+ #[tauri::command]
+ pub fn apply_floating_bar_vibrancy(app: AppHandle, window_label: Option<String>) -> Result<(), String> {
+     let label = window_label.unwrap_or_else(|| "floating-bar".to_string());
+ 
+     if let Some(window) = app.get_webview_window(&label) {
+         // Apply vibrancy using window-vibrancy
+         #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
+         {
+             use window_vibrancy::{apply_vibrancy, NSVisualEffectMaterial, NSVisualEffectState};
+ 
+             match apply_vibrancy(
+                 &window,
+                 NSVisualEffectMaterial::HudWindow,
+                 Some(NSVisualEffectState::Active),
+                 Some(24.0) // Corner radius for rounded bar
+             ) {
+                 Ok(_) => {
+                     info!("✅ Successfully applied vibrancy to floating bar: {}", label);
+                     info!("🎨 Vibrancy material: HudWindow, State: Active, Corner radius: 24px");
+ 
+                     // Additional macOS-specific styling
+                     if let Ok(ns_window_ptr) = window.ns_window() {
+                         let ns_window = ns_window_ptr as cocoa_id;
+                         unsafe {
+                             // Make window background clear for vibrancy effect
+                             use objc::runtime::Class;
+                             use objc::{msg_send, sel, sel_impl};
+ 
+                             let clear_color: cocoa_id = msg_send![Class::get("NSColor").unwrap(), clearColor];
+                             let _: () = msg_send![ns_window, setBackgroundColor: clear_color];
+ 
+                             // Set window to be non-opaque for vibrancy to work
+                             let _: () = msg_send![ns_window, setOpaque: NO];
+ 
+                             // Ensure the window has a shadow for better vibrancy effect
+                             let _: () = msg_send![ns_window, setHasShadow: YES];
+ 
+                             // Set the window level to floating for better visibility
+                             let _: () = msg_send![ns_window, setLevel: 3]; // NSFloatingWindowLevel
+ 
+                             // Ensure window is interactive (not click-through)
+                             let _: () = msg_send![ns_window, setIgnoresMouseEvents: NO];
+                             info!("🖱️ Floating bar '{}' set to interactive (not click-through)", label);
+                         }
+                     }
+                 }
+                 Err(e) => {
+                     let error_msg = format!("Failed to apply vibrancy to floating bar: {}", e);
+                     warn!("{}", error_msg);
+                     return Err(error_msg);
+                 }
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
+         {
+             info!("Floating bar vibrancy applied via CSS for window: {} (non-macOS)", label);
+         }
+ 
+         Ok(())
+     } else {
+         Err(format!("Floating bar window '{}' not found", label))
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ /// Remove vibrancy from the floating bar window
+ #[tauri::command]
+ pub fn remove_floating_bar_vibrancy(app: AppHandle, window_label: Option<String>) -> Result<(), String> {
+     let label = window_label.unwrap_or_else(|| "floating-bar".to_string());
+ 
+     if let Some(window) = app.get_webview_window(&label) {
+         #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
+         {
+             use window_vibrancy::clear_vibrancy;
+ 
+             match clear_vibrancy(&window) {
+                 Ok(_) => {
+                     info!("✅ Successfully removed vibrancy from floating bar: {}", label);
+                 }
+                 Err(e) => {
+                     let error_msg = format!("Failed to remove vibrancy from floating bar: {}", e);
+                     warn!("{}", error_msg);
+                     return Err(error_msg);
+                 }
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
+         {
+             info!("Vibrancy removed via CSS for floating bar: {} (non-macOS)", label);
+         }
+ 
+         Ok(())
+     } else {
+         Err(format!("Floating bar window '{}' not found", label))
+     }
+ }
  
```

```diff
+   padding: 1px;
+   background: linear-gradient(
+     135deg,
+     rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) 0%,
+     rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 50%,
+     rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) 100%
+   );
+   mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
+   mask-composite: exclude;
+   -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
+   -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
+ }
+ 
+ /* Different vibrancy intensities for floating bar */
+ .floating-bar-light-vibrancy {
+   backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(120%);
+   -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(120%);
+   background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
+ }
+ 
+ .floating-bar-medium-vibrancy {
+   backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(150%);
+   -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(150%);
+   background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
+ }
+ 
+ .floating-bar-heavy-vibrancy {
+   backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(200%);
+   -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(200%);
+   background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
+ }
+ 
+ /* State-based vibrancy colors for floating bar */
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy.state-idle {
+   background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
+   border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
+ }
+ 
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy.state-listening {
+   background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15);
+   border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2);
+ }
+ 
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy.state-processing {
+   background: rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.15);
+   border-color: rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.2);
+ }
+ 
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy.state-speaking {
+   background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15);
+   border-color: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.2);
+ }
+ 
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy.state-error {
+   background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15);
+   border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2);
+ }
+ 
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy.state-success {
+   background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
+   border-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2);
+ }
+ 
+ /* Hover effects for vibrancy floating bar */
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy:hover {
+   transform: scale(1.02);
+   background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
+   border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
+   transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
+ }
+ 
+ /* Animated vibrancy background */
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy.animated {
+   background: linear-gradient(
+     -45deg,
+     rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08),
+     rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03),
+     rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08),
+     rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)
+   );
+   background-size: 400% 400%;
+   animation: floating-bar-gradient 4s ease infinite;
+ }
+ 
+ @keyframes floating-bar-gradient {
+   0% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
+   50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
+   100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
+ }
+ 
+ /* Content styling within vibrancy floating bar */
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy .floating-bar-content {
+   position: relative;
+   z-index: 2;
+   color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
+   text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
+ }
+ 
+ /* Responsive vibrancy design for floating bar */
+ @media (max-width: 768px) {
+   .floating-bar-vibrancy {
+     backdrop-filter: blur(15px) saturate(140%);
+     -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(15px) saturate(140%);
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ /* macOS-specific vibrancy optimizations */
+ @supports (-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(1px)) {
+   .floating-bar-vibrancy {
+     /* Enhanced vibrancy for WebKit browsers (Safari/macOS) */
+     -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(25px) saturate(180%) brightness(1.1);
+     background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
+   }
+ }
```

```diff
+ /// Apply vibrancy to the floating bar
+ #[tauri::command]
+ pub fn apply_floating_bar_vibrancy(app: AppHandle) -> Result<(), String> {
+     info!("Applying vibrancy to floating bar");
+ 
+     if let Some(window) = app.get_webview_window(crate::constants::window_labels::FLOATING_PANEL) {
+         // Apply vibrancy using window-vibrancy
+         #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
+         {
+             use window_vibrancy::{apply_vibrancy, NSVisualEffectMaterial, NSVisualEffectState};
+ 
+             match apply_vibrancy(
+                 &window,
+                 NSVisualEffectMaterial::HudWindow,
+                 Some(NSVisualEffectState::Active),
+                 Some(24.0) // Corner radius for rounded appearance
+             ) {
+                 Ok(_) => {
+                     info!("✅ Successfully applied vibrancy to floating bar");
+                     info!("🎨 Vibrancy material: HudWindow with 24px corner radius");
+ 
+                     // Additional macOS-specific styling
+                     if let Ok(ns_window_ptr) = window.ns_window() {
+                         let ns_window = ns_window_ptr as cocoa_id;
+                         unsafe {
+                             // Make window background clear for vibrancy effect
+                             use objc::runtime::Class;
+                             use objc::{msg_send, sel, sel_impl};
+ 
+                             let clear_color: cocoa_id = msg_send![Class::get("NSColor").unwrap(), clearColor];
+                             let _: () = msg_send![ns_window, setBackgroundColor: clear_color];
+ 
+                             // Set window to be non-opaque for vibrancy to work
+                             let _: () = msg_send![ns_window, setOpaque: NO];
+ 
+                             // Ensure the window has a shadow for better vibrancy effect
+                             let _: () = msg_send![ns_window, setHasShadow: YES];
+ 
+                             // Set the window level to floating for better visibility
+                             let _: () = msg_send![ns_window, setLevel: 3]; // NSFloatingWindowLevel
+ 
+                             info!("🖱️ Floating bar window configured for vibrancy");
+                         }
+                     }
+                 }
+                 Err(e) => {
+                     let error_msg = format!("Failed to apply vibrancy: {}", e);
+                     warn!("{}", error_msg);
+                     return Err(error_msg);
+                 }
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
+         {
+             info!("Vibrancy applied via CSS for floating bar (non-macOS)");
+         }
+ 
+         Ok(())
+     } else {
+         Err("Floating bar window not found".to_string())
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ /// Remove vibrancy from the floating bar
+ #[tauri::command]
+ pub fn remove_floating_bar_vibrancy(app: AppHandle) -> Result<(), String> {
+     info!("Removing vibrancy from floating bar");
+ 
+     if let Some(window) = app.get_webview_window(crate::constants::window_labels::FLOATING_PANEL) {
+         #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
+         {
+             use window_vibrancy::clear_vibrancy;
+ 
+             match clear_vibrancy(&window) {
+                 Ok(_) => {
+                     info!("✅ Successfully removed vibrancy from floating bar");
+                 }
+                 Err(e) => {
+                     let error_msg = format!("Failed to remove vibrancy: {}", e);
+                     warn!("{}", error_msg);
+                     return Err(error_msg);
+                 }
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
+         {
+             info!("Vibrancy removed via CSS for floating bar (non-macOS)");
+         }
+ 
+         Ok(())
+     } else {
+         Err("Floating bar window not found".to_string())
+     }
+ }
```

```diff
+ 
+ /* Floating Bar Vibrancy Effects */
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy {
+   /* Base vibrancy effect for floating bar */
+   backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
+   -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
+   background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
+   border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
+   border-radius: 24px; /* Matches native corner radius */
+   position: relative;
+   overflow: hidden;
+ }
+ 
+ /* Vibrancy intensity variations */
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy.vibrancy-light {
+   backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(120%);
+   -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(120%);
+   background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
+ }
+ 
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy.vibrancy-medium {
+   backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(150%);
+   -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(150%);
+   background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
+ }
+ 
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy.vibrancy-heavy {
+   backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(200%);
+   -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(200%);
+   background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
+ }
+ 
+ /* State-based vibrancy colors */
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy.vibrancy-idle {
+   background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
+   border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
+ }
+ 
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy.vibrancy-listening {
+   background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2);
+   border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3);
+ }
+ 
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy.vibrancy-processing {
+   background: rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.2);
+   border-color: rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.3);
+ }
+ 
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy.vibrancy-speaking {
+   background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.2);
+   border-color: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.3);
+ }
+ 
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy.vibrancy-error {
+   background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2);
+   border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3);
+ }
+ 
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy.vibrancy-success {
+   background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.2);
+   border-color: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.3);
+ }
+ 
+ /* Hover effects for vibrancy */
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy:hover {
+   transform: scale(1.02);
+   background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
+   border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
+   transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
+ }
+ 
+ /* Animated vibrancy background */
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy.vibrancy-animated {
+   background: linear-gradient(
+     -45deg,
+     rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1),
+     rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05),
+     rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1),
+     rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)
+   );
+   background-size: 400% 400%;
+   animation: vibrancy-gradient 4s ease infinite;
+ }
+ 
+ @keyframes vibrancy-gradient {
+   0% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
+   50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
+   100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
+ }
+ 
+ /* Content styling within vibrancy container */
+ .floating-bar-vibrancy-content {
+   display: flex;
+   align-items: center;
+   justify-content: center;
+   gap: 8px;
+   height: 100%;
+   position: relative;
+   z-index: 2;
+   color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
+   text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
+ }
+ 
+ /* Responsive vibrancy design */
+ @media (max-width: 768px) {
+   .floating-bar-vibrancy {
+     backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(150%);
+     -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(150%);
+   }
+ }
```
